goal: Play a full round and use the new feature: Create executable checks (forge checks --plan) that run a live playtest and assert the telemetry counters: map_built=1, plaza_built=1, themes_built=6, plot_assigned (after claim or the 20s auto-claim), auto_claims, cubes_dropped rising about every 2s, cubes_collected rising, cashin_fx_sent>0, and Cash rising. Also assert that there are no output errors or warnings and that cubes_dropped stays 0 before a claim. Run them, then hand any failing check to the fixer. Keep existing counter names unchanged.
summary: The playtester waited out the auto-claim, bought two upgrades, opened the shop and let the dropper run. It saw map_built=1, plaza_built=1, plot_assigned=1, and cubes_dropped, cubes_collected and cashin_fx_sent all rising with Cash climbing. The themes_built=6 check fails (the counter is 12) and checks_failed=1 is set. The pre-claim cubes_dropped=0 check was never confirmed, and no failing check was handed to a fixer.

bugs.title: themes_built counter is 12, expected 6
bugs.evidence: Probe counters at the end show themes_built=12 while map_built=1 and plaza_built=1. The playtester also saw 12 at step 1. checks_failed=1 matches this failed assertion. The themes are probably built twice, or the counter is incremented twice.

bugs.title: Claim and auto-claim counters double-count with a single player
bugs.evidence: Only one player is present, yet plots_claimed=2 and auto_claims=2 while plot_assigned=1. The claim or auto-claim path probably runs twice, or the counters are incremented twice. This makes the auto_claims and plot_assigned checks ambiguous.
